steps: Add an acceptance/review gate bound to normalized source bytes and explicit evidence checks.
Smoke-test a source archive in an isolated temporary directory.
Use GitHub verification as the required check before publication.
Publish a versioned alpha release and verify its downloaded archive.
Turn workflow failures and user reports into structured intake artifacts, with deduplication.
Exercise a real PR, CI, release and feedback round trip, then record the actual remote URLs and remaining limits.
